_doc: Accounts excluded from all metrics: our own accounts, seeded/placeholder rows, QA and test accounts, and automated browser/HTTP clients. Every excluded account is still COUNTED and surfaced in the report so exclusions are never silent. Patterns are SQL ILIKE (use % as wildcard). userAgentRegex is a POSIX regex matched case-insensitively against auth.sessions.user_agent — a user is excluded if ANY of their sessions matches.
_userSqlDoc: userSql (global or per app): raw SQL predicates over `u` (auth.users), OR-ed into the excluded_users CTE. For truth the app itself records about an account (an admin-set test flag), which patterns cannot express.

global._emailPatternsDoc: Shapes that can only be ours, matched with SQL ILIKE. bstockman1+%@% is the owner plus-addressed: a plus tag routes to the owner mailbox, so no external person can hold one, and every test signup made that way is excluded without another config change. It currently covers brassmonkey382 (bstockman1+1@hotmail.com, added 2026-08-25) and bstockman1+2@hotmail.com. The untagged owner addresses live in emailExact below.
global._userAgentRegexDoc: Four groups, in order. (1) Automation drivers and HTTP clients. (2) Self-declaring crawlers: `bot/` catches ClaudeBot/Googlebot/bingbot/AhrefsBot etc, and the `+http` / `+contact@` forms catch anything advertising a contact URL or address the way the robots convention asks. (3) Named agents that declare themselves but match neither of the above — Claude-User and Perplexity-User are USER-INITIATED fetchers with their own UA, distinct from ClaudeBot, and Dataprovider.com names itself with no marker at all. (4) Impossible UAs: a null header stringified to `None`, legacy EdgeHTML (Edge/12-18, retired 2020) bolted onto a modern Chrome token, a truncated `Safari/537.3` (real is 537.36), `Mac OS X 8_` (never existed; real is 10_x or 14_x+), and AppleWebKit/558 (real is 537.36 or 605.1.15). Each of group 4 was observed in this project's traffic on 2026-08-06 and none can be emitted by a real browser. Verified: this costs 0 real signed-in accounts.
global._emailExactDoc: Owner accounts, global because the same person signs into every app. brassmonkey381@msn.com matches Brian's GitHub handle and signs in from his dev machine (confirmed 2026-08-04).
global._ipsDoc: IP exclusions live in .env as EXCLUDED_IPS (comma-separated), NOT here — an IP address identifies a physical location and this file is committed. They exclude ANONYMOUS GUESTS ONLY: real signed-in accounts are never dropped by IP, because a dev box shares its address with everyone else on that network (a genuine external user has signed in from the dev IP, which is exactly why this rule is guest-scoped). Exclude real accounts by email instead.

doggle._note: doggle.invalid = seeded synthetic accounts; doggle.club = our own staff/company accounts.
doggle._userSqlDoc: Doggle's own test-account flags (added 2026-10-24 at the Doggle session's request): profiles.is_test_account is set by an admin or the 0447/0450 backfills (seed, QA, App Review and demo accounts); profiles.is_fake marks the Long Beach / Alameda sim accounts (0192). The app's flag is authoritative where an email pattern is only a guess; the first account it caught that no pattern did was Apple's App Review tester (Sign in with Apple, GPS in Milpitas).
userSql: exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = u.id and (p.is_test_account or p.is_fake))

pickleague._note: unclaimed.pickleague.club = auto-generated placeholder rows for imported roster players who never signed up (the 2026-07-29 bulk import); pickleague.test = QA accounts.
pickleague._userSqlDoc: Pickleague's own flags (added 2026-10-24): profiles.is_test_account is admin-set (the hide-test-accounts switch's list of QA, review and demo accounts); profiles.is_unclaimed marks the imported placeholder rows. On 2026-10-24 every flagged account was already caught by a pattern above; the flag is here so the app's own list stays authoritative when a QA account is made with an ordinary address.
userSql: exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id = u.id and (p.is_test_account or p.is_unclaimed))

tcgscan._note: official@michi-maker.com is our own company account. Owner personal accounts are in global.emailExact, not repeated here.

michi-maker._userSqlDoc: Michi QA walks (michi session, 2026-11-05): every scripted Playwright walk against production or the dev server arrives with utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=qa&utm_campaign=<round> (utm_source must stay reddit for the seeded landing to fire). Each walk is a fresh anonymous guest, so no email or id can list it; the session.start it writes carries utm_medium=qa and that marks the uid. Before this marker (the 2026-11-05 11:05 to 12:02 UTC walks) QA guests are indistinguishable from traffic and are noted in config/events.json instead. DEV MODE (MIC-017, LIVE from michi 78aef01, 2026-11-10 00:30:42 UTC, run 27c742): a browser that visited ?dev=1 stamps props.dev = true on every analytics_events row (session.start included) until turned off; it is Brian testing redesign pieces on production, so any uid with ANY event carrying dev=true is excluded whole (not only session.start: a dev visit opened inside an already-live session has no new session.start, michi 2026-11-09), the same way as utm_medium=qa. No Reddit pixel or CAPI fires in dev mode.
userSql: u.id in (select e.user_id from public.analytics_events e where e.name = 'session.start' and e.props->>'utm_medium' = 'qa' and e.user_id is not null)
u.id in (select e.user_id from public.analytics_events e where e.props->>'dev' = 'true' and e.user_id is not null)
